prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a parking lot collision claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is not represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1321; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened following report of a low-speed collision in a parking lot. Claimant reports being struck while backing out of a space. Police report not filed; both parties exchanged information at the scene. Claimant states she is not represented by an attorney.

Entry 2: Called claimant to confirm contact details and obtain recorded statement. Claimant describes minor vehicle damage to rear bumper and reports neck pain beginning later the same day. She has not yet seen a physician. Advised her of the medical evaluation options available under the policy.

Entry 3: Received photos of both vehicles from claimant and from the insured driver. Damage appears consistent with a slow-speed impact. Requested repair estimate from the body shop of the claimant's choosing. Reminded claimant she may contact her own insurer if she prefers.

Entry 4: Claimant reports she visited an urgent care clinic and was diagnosed with a neck strain. Requested itemized medical records with her signed authorization. She asked whether she needs a lawyer; explained that I cannot give legal advice and that she is free to seek independent counsel if she wishes.

Entry 5: Reviewed the file. Liability appears likely to rest with the insured driver based on the statements and photos. Injury claim is under evaluation pending receipt of medical records and the repair estimate. Set a follow-up to contact claimant in ten business days for status.
